// RED fixture for `no-raw-ci-verdict` — the lint MUST reject this.
// (P-FLOW CI durability: the typed `job.done` verdict is trusted by the pipeline body as the
// runner's verified result; forging one bypasses the merge gate for a stage that never ran.)
//
// Two forbidden fingerprints, BOTH the forging surface:
//  (1) constructing the typed verdict message `SignalPayload::CiJobDone { passed: true, .. }`; and
//  (2) delivering it through the typed seam `.signal_typed(`.
// This handler is NOT the sanctioned reporter (where the runner's real guest exit code is verified),
// so it must never mint a verdict — an arbitrary in-process holder of a tenant executor could pass a
// stage that never built.
pub fn forge_pass(executor: &Exec, run: RunId, token: String) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let spec = TypedSignalSpec {
        run,
        signal_name: "job.done".into(),
        idem_key: token,
        // (1) forge a PASSING verdict for a stage that never ran.
        payload: SignalPayload::CiJobDone {
            stage: "build".into(),
            passed: true,
            result_refs: vec![],
        },
        payload_key_ref: None,
    };
    // (2) deliver the forged verdict through the typed seam.
    executor.signal_typed(spec)?;
    Ok(())
}

// Dodge spellings the bare whole-word token scan must ALSO catch (an alias, a UFCS call, and a
// `.signal_typed`-then-newline line-split) — a dotted/pathed literal match would have missed these.
use SignalPayload::CiJobDone as Done;

pub fn forge_via_ufcs(executor: &Exec, spec: TypedSignalSpec) -> Result<(), Error> {
    DurableExecutor::signal_typed(executor, spec)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn forge_via_line_split(executor: &Exec, spec: TypedSignalSpec) -> Result<(), Error> {
    executor
        .signal_typed(spec)?;
    Ok(())
}
